purpose: Source delivery verification, not a new architecture promotion or formal performance acceptance.

source_audit.limitations: Pattern-based secret checks are not a proof that all confidential information has been identified. Private inputs, map binaries, caches and experiment outputs are excluded.

python_environment.collection_rule: Run each package separately with default pytest import mode; ROS launch_testing autoload and duplicate test module names require this harness isolation.

local_fixture_recheck.location: Original workspace with source hashes equal to the staged and independently tested snapshot

smac_host_recheck.scope: Tiny generated straight-path smoke test, not a full navigation mission.

build.build_and_install: Independent temporary directories; existing dependency overlay sourced read-only
disclosed_warnings: Existing OMPL variadic macro and Python module initializer warnings
ROS overlay runtime library search path cycle warnings in both Nav2 adapters
Unused PYTHON_EXECUTABLE variable in one CMake package
build.first_attempt: Sandbox build stalled after configuration; only its identified process was stopped. Host-side isolated retry with explicit system Python completed.

whitespace.scope: Historical Markdown hard line breaks / EOF blanks and existing arena_evaluation_msgs XML/CMake whitespace

reproduction_limits: Private-map tests require separately authorized input data and frozen experiment fixtures.
Current Nav2 adapters still bind frozen r1/r2 experimental runtime sources; this snapshot does not certify stable whole-vehicle integration.
